lessons.title: Introduction to Databases 🗄️
lessons.description: Understand what a relational database is, and the roles of tables, rows, columns, and keys.

lessons.title: Getting Started with SQL 💬
lessons.description: Learn what SQL is, how to set up SQLite, and run your very first query.

lessons.title: SELECT: Choosing Columns & Distinct Values 🎯
lessons.description: Retrieve specific columns, use DISTINCT to remove duplicates, and limit result rows.

lessons.title: Filtering Rows with WHERE 🔍
lessons.description: Apply conditions to get exactly the rows you need using WHERE, comparisons, AND/OR, IN, BETWEEN.

lessons.title: Sorting Results with ORDER BY 🔃
lessons.description: Order your query results ascending or descending by one or multiple columns.
